Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Current UMVPA cutover now supplies operator-native relation/RelationRdm/query infrastructure alongside labeled RSA; the September account predates this adopted architecture. No new observation-level API gap or PyMVPA parity was reproduced by this audit.

Fresh context: Yes: deferred API reassessment; premise updated.

Next action: For a concrete observation-level consumer, demonstrate the missing workflow against current relation/RDM APIs and decide observations versus aggregated-condition semantics before adding a new scorer. If covered, close with a verified example; descriptive similarity is not inference.

Evidence: modules/mvpa/.../relation/{RelationRdm,Queries,ObservationMeanRelations}.scala; UMVPA M2/M3 receipts; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

PyMVPA PDistTargetSimilarity is numerically reproducible from MeasuredObservationRdm, but ScalaFIM exposes no first-class observation-RDM model query. Decide whether this belongs as a typed observation estimand, should require explicit promotion to relational evidence, or remains downstream. Acceptance: one ownership decision, laws, and documentation; no ad-hoc generic scorer.

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3, but the named API premise is stale for current main. No MeasuredObservationRdm implementation was found in current modules. Current modules/mvpa/Rsa.scala already provides LabeledRdm with unique item identities and explicit alignment, RdmModel, SamplewiseRsaDesign, RdmScorer and model scoring. The historical numerical reproducibility claim is not a current public-workflow reproduction and was not requalified here.

Refined ownership/scope: an observation-level scientific RDM/model comparison belongs with the existing native MVPA/RSA contracts when a concrete ScalaFIM consumer needs it. Do not create a parallel generic scorer or automatically convert observations to condition/relational evidence to satisfy an API shape. First demonstrate the missing workflow against current labeled-RDM/scoring APIs (or identify and qualify the exact proposed branch), specifying what the items represent, their identity/alignment, distance metric and pair-selection rule, and whether repeated observations are exchangeable for any inference. If existing APIs cover the case, close with a verified example rather than adding another hierarchy.

Any new abstraction must preserve the distinction between observations and aggregated conditions, with duplicate/substituted/reordered item tests and an independent numeric example. Descriptive similarity does not imply inferential validity. Keep the source of the original PyMVPA parity claim explicit and verify it only when the concrete workflow is selected. No new implementation, parity result or automatic promotion policy is admitted by this assessment.
